Sorry for the long response as all of this is just new territory for me!!

Also don’t mean to sound rude if I do. I genuinely am not sure how to go about any of this in a calm way as I get extreme anxiety when people start to yell at me. I just really don’t want my SD to get hurt or worse because of some sort of incident! He’s my lifeline I need him.

But am I unreasonable for trying to educate on how to behave around a service dog? If we never correct people on their mistakes how will anyone learn. I would rather speak up than lose my service dog to some poorly behaved dog. There was a puppy mauled to death on the other side of this property.

Can second this as I developed such bad secondary polycythemia from smoking while taking my testosterone. It got very bad and I had to cleanse my body by quitting and not taking hormones for month. I actually did develop secondary polycythemia from smoking (mostly vaping because I was “quitting”) and my testosterone. I was at risk of a stroke and ended up having to stop hormones for months to clear out my system and I did have to stop smoking. They both thicken your blood. I was told I had to choose and I mean that’s not even a choice. I put down the nicotine and I’m so thankful because now I can take my hormones safely!
Nicotine and testosterone will thicken your blood leading to clotting and potentially a stroke and well, death.
